deficiencies.description: The text states 'So invasion and malignancy are really, really important diagnostically. So it's defined as the ability to invade the surrounding tissue.', leaving the pronoun 'it' ambiguous between invasion and malignancy. The rewrite resolves this ambiguity by specifying that malignancy is defined as the ability to invade surrounding tissue, thereby choosing one reading of an unclear statement.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: So invasion and malignancy are really, really important diagnostically. So it's defined as the ability to invade the surrounding tissue.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: Invasion and malignancy are very important diagnostically, and malignancy is defined as the ability to invade the surrounding tissue.

deficiencies.description: The rewrite replaces the pointing word 'this' with 'Invasion' ('Invasion is therefore probably an obligatory step...'), but the surrounding text discusses multiple processes and states (invasion, shedding of cells, surviving at secondary sites) without showing unequivocally that 'this' refers solely to invasion.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: So this is probably an obligatory step in getting to having a malignant metastasizing tumor.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: Invasion is therefore probably an obligatory step in arriving at a malignant, metastasising tumour.
